description: List open jobs from a company career page on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters or Recruitee. Use when asked what a company is hiring for. Returns title, department, location, remote flag, salary when published, posted date and apply URL. Max 10 rows per call, up to 5 companies. When company values are plain slugs (e.g. "airbnb"), ats is required; it is not needed for prefixed values such as ashby:ramp or a career-page URL.

ats.description: Required when company values are plain slugs. Not needed for ashby:ramp or a career-page URL.

company.description: Company slugs or career-page URLs, e.g. "airbnb". Max 5.

include_description.description: Include the full job description text.

keyword.description: Only jobs whose title or text contains one of these.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (0 = any).

name: search_jobs
title: Search company jobs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee)
